evidence.snippet: On the pilot group selection—I think we should be careful about who we include. Some of our youths are dealing with quite a bit right now. Should we prioritize those who are more stable, or do we want a mix? I'm thinking about the trauma-informed angle here.

For A2, should we include a section on trauma history or triggers? I want to make sure we're not asking staff to diagnose, but knowing what we know about each youth's background could help with the support plan.
I can help with the briefing. I'll prepare some talking points on how to use A4 and A7 during handovers.
